log.msg: Dawn, day 1. High Moor. Water everywhere, much of it foul. Rain and cold nights.
Somewhere to the north there is a town. Find it: its people know what this land is waiting for.
Your camp has a well. A cloak, a lantern and fuel are stored here: open Pack to take them.
A rare year: a year of thin air. Every step is harder work, but the air is so clear you see much further.
A long world, 5 regions by 3: a narrow land, short one way and long the other.
God mode: nothing can see you, hurt you or stop you.
You are in the Lantern Grotto (fungus cavern), level 4.
God mode is off. You are mortal again.
